# morphicons vendored runtime

- Upstream: https://github.com/guillermolg00/morphicons
- Version: 1.7.0
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)
- Entry used by dsh-Remote: `element.js`

The files in this directory are the unmodified browser distribution needed by
the Web Component entry. They are kept local so the zero-build WebUI does not
depend on a CDN or a runtime npm resolution step.
